description: This file defines a set of tools and schemas for interacting with the Google Calendar API, including operations for events, calendars, and free/busy queries. It includes class implementations for each operation and a factory function to create tools based on specified actions.

classes.name: BaseGoogleCalendarTool
classes.description: Base class providing common request functionality for Google Calendar API interactions.

classes.name: ListEventsTool
classes.description: Tool for listing events from a Google Calendar.

classes.name: CreateEventTool
classes.description: Tool for creating new events in Google Calendar.

classes.name: GetEventTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving specific event details.

classes.name: UpdateEventTool
classes.description: Tool for updating existing calendar events.

classes.name: QuickAddEventTool
classes.description: Tool for quick adding events via natural language.

classes.name: ClearCalendarTool
classes.description: Tool for clearing all events from a calendar.

classes.name: QueryFreebusyTool
classes.description: Tool for querying free/busy information for calendars.

methods.name: makeGoogleCalendarRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the Google Calendar API with proper headers and error handling.

methods.name: createGoogleCalendarTools
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns a list of calendar tools based on specified actions.
